name: Kukuri Youichi
source:
"Why are you staring at us, boy?"

The eldest son of the Kukuri family. Also an executive at the company run by the Kukuri family. An unpleasant guy who looks down on everyone but himself. He also disliked his father, Kiyomasa. Arrogant and self-centered.
